product.olivetti-m6-640.summary: The M6-640 combined a single Pentium with the professional range’s PCI expansion options.
product.olivetti-m6-640.history: Olivetti presented it at CeBIT in 1994 as part of its professional range.
product.olivetti-m6-640.architecture: The board determines whether a video card is needed. The BA2139 has onboard graphics and the BA2144 leaves it out.
product.olivetti-m6-640.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-640.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-640.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 11
product.olivetti-m6-640.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.16.
